name: Houselights
oneLiner: A live-production and venue-programming company — bookings, build, light, sound, and rooms that know what they are doing.
paletteSeed: blue-hour signage — dusk teal-navy field, tungsten-amber type-light, cream deco panel for the one lights-on section, show-dark floor; palette taken from lit marquees at dusk, never flat fills
typeDirection: Big Shoulders variable (condensed Chicago-poster display; the letterboard voice) + Big Shoulders Inline (bulb-lit channel-letter moments: wordmark and the neon sign) + Libre Caslon Text and italic (printed-programme register) — all OFL, vendored
motionBudget: one continuous scroll-driven lighting state (a dimmer takes the page toward show-dark, a warm restore rises at curtain; the stills brighten and their light sources bloom as the day loses — dusk physics) + the lobby letterboard riding the corner, re-lettering only on act changes with staggered tile flips + one slow old-neon flicker on a single letter of the closing sign; reduced-motion gets instant swaps, steady sign, position-mapped light only; no-JS gets the full static page with the board's default lines
